mapper.select: SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, a.employee_id AS employeeId, e.company_id AS companyId, e.department_id AS departmentId, e.employee_name AS employeeName, a.login_id AS loginId, a.password_hash AS passwordHash, a.account_status AS accountStatus, a.locked_until AS lockedUntil FROM accounts a JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = a.employee_id WHERE a.login_id = #{loginId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT authority FROM ( SELECT r.role_code AS authority FROM account_roles ar JOIN roles r ON r.role_id = ar.role_id WHERE ar.account_id = #{accountId} AND r.active = TRUE AND (ar.expires_at IS NULL OR ar.expires_at > NOW(6)) UNION SELECT p.permission_code AS authority FROM account_roles ar JOIN roles r ON r.role_id = ar.role_id AND r.active = TRUE JOIN role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id = r.role_id JOIN permissions p ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id WHERE ar.account_id = #{accountId} AND (ar.expires_at IS NULL OR ar.expires_at > NOW(6)) ) authorities
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE accounts SET failed_login_count = failed_login_count + 1, account_status = CASE WHEN failed_login_count + 1 >= 5 THEN 'LOCKED' ELSE account_status END, locked_until = CASE WHEN failed_login_count + 1 >= 5 THEN DATE_ADD(NOW(6), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) ELSE locked_until END WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE accounts SET failed_login_count = 0, account_status = 'ACTIVE', locked_until = NULL, last_login_at = NOW(6), last_login_ip = #{ip} WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_histories (account_id, attempted_login_id, success, failure_reason, ip_address, user_agent, logged_in_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{loginId}, #{success}, #{failureReason}, #{ip}, #{userAgent}, NOW(6))
mapper.select: SELECT company_id FROM companies WHERE company_code = #{code} LIMIT 1
SELECT department_id FROM departments WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND department_code = #{code} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT position_id FROM positions WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND position_code = #{code} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT role_id FROM roles WHERE role_code = #{code} AND active = TRUE LIMIT 1

SELECT leave_policy_id FROM leave_policies WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND active = TRUE AND effective_from <= #{date} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= #{date}) ORDER BY effective_from DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT work_policy_id FROM work_policies WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND active = TRUE AND effective_from <= #{date} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= #{date}) ORDER BY effective_from DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employees (company_id, department_id, position_id, employee_number, employee_name, email, phone, hire_date, employment_status, employment_type, memo) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{departmentId}, #{positionId}, #{employeeNumber}, #{employeeName}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{hireDate}, #{employmentStatus}, #{employmentType}, #{memo})

INSERT INTO accounts (employee_id, login_id, password_hash, account_status, password_changed_at, must_change_password, created_by_account_id) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{loginId}, #{passwordHash}, 'ACTIVE', NOW(6), #{mustChangePassword}, #{createdByAccountId})
INSERT IGNORE INTO account_roles (account_id, role_id, assigned_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{roleId}, NOW(6))
INSERT IGNORE INTO leave_balances (employee_id, leave_policy_id, balance_year, granted_days) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{policyId}, #{year}, #{grantedDays})
INSERT IGNORE INTO employee_work_policy_assignments (employee_id, work_policy_id, effective_from) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{policyId}, #{effectiveFrom})
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_records ar JOIN employees ae ON ae.employee_id = ar.employee_id WHERE ae.company_id = #{companyId} AND ar.work_date = CURRENT_DATE() AND ar.clock_in_at IS NOT NULL) AS todayAttendance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leave_requests lr JOIN employees le ON le.employee_id = lr.employee_id WHERE le.company_id = #{companyId} AND lr.status = 'APPROVED' AND CURRENT_DATE() BETWEEN lr.start_date AND lr.end_date) AS todayLeave, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_lines al WHERE al.approver_employee_id = #{employeeId} AND al.status = 'PENDING') AS pendingApprovals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications n JOIN accounts na ON na.account_id = n.recipient_account_id WHERE na.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND n.read_at IS NULL) AS unreadNotifications

SELECT n.notice_id AS noticeId, n.title, n.pinned, n.view_count AS viewCount, n.published_at AS publishedAt, e.employee_name AS authorName FROM notices n JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = n.author_account_id JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = a.employee_id WHERE n.company_id = #{companyId} AND n.published = TRUE AND n.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY n.pinned DESC, n.published_at DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT ce.calendar_event_id AS eventId, ce.event_type AS eventType, ce.title, ce.starts_at AS startsAt, ce.ends_at AS endsAt, ce.location, ce.color FROM calendar_events ce WHERE ce.company_id = #{companyId} AND ce.deleted_at IS NULL AND ce.canceled_at IS NULL AND ce.starts_at < DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND ce.ends_at >= CURRENT_DATE() AND (ce.visibility IN ('COMPANY', 'DEPARTMENT') OR ce.organizer_employee_id = #{employeeId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM calendar_event_participants cep WHERE cep.calendar_event_id = ce.calendar_event_id AND cep.employee_id = #{employeeId})) ORDER BY ce.starts_at LIMIT 5

SELECT ad.approval_document_id AS documentId, ad.title, ad.document_type AS documentType, de.employee_name AS drafterName, al.requested_at AS requestedAt FROM approval_lines al JOIN approval_documents ad ON ad.approval_document_id = al.approval_document_id JOIN employees de ON de.employee_id = ad.drafter_employee_id WHERE al.approver_employee_id = #{employeeId} AND al.status = 'PENDING' AND ad.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY al.requested_at LIMIT 5

SELECT d.department_id AS departmentId, d.department_code AS departmentCode, d.department_name AS departmentName, d.parent_department_id AS parentDepartmentId, pd.department_name AS parentDepartmentName, d.leader_employee_id AS leaderEmployeeId, le.employee_name AS leaderName, d.description, d.sort_order AS sortOrder, COUNT(e.employee_id) AS employeeCount FROM departments d LEFT JOIN departments pd ON pd.department_id = d.parent_department_id LEFT JOIN employees le ON le.employee_id = d.leader_employee_id LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.department_id = d.department_id AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.employment_status != 'RESIGNED' WHERE d.company_id = #{companyId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_code, d.department_name, d.parent_department_id, pd.department_name, d.leader_employee_id, le.employee_name, d.description, d.sort_order ORDER BY d.sort_order, d.department_name

SELECT p.position_id AS positionId, p.position_code AS positionCode, p.position_name AS positionName, p.position_level AS positionLevel, p.sort_order AS sortOrder, COUNT(e.employee_id) AS employeeCount FROM positions p LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.position_id = p.position_id AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.employment_status != 'RESIGNED' WHERE p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.position_id, p.position_code, p.position_name, p.position_level, p.sort_order ORDER BY p.sort_order, p.position_level

SELECT leave_type_id AS leaveTypeId, leave_type_code AS leaveTypeCode, leave_type_name AS leaveTypeName, deducts_annual_leave AS deductsAnnualLeave, requires_attachment AS requiresAttachment FROM leave_types WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND active = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order

SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_name AS employeeName, e.employee_number AS employeeNumber, d.department_name AS departmentName, p.position_name AS positionName FROM employees e LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.position_id = e.position_id WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.employment_status != 'RESIGNED' ORDER BY d.sort_order, p.position_level DESC, e.employee_name

SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, e.employee_name AS employeeName, e.employee_number AS employeeNumber, d.department_name AS departmentName FROM accounts a JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = a.employee_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND a.account_id != #{excludeAccountId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY e.employee_name

SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_number AS employeeNumber, e.employee_name AS employeeName, e.email, e.phone, e.department_id AS departmentId, d.department_name AS departmentName, e.position_id AS positionId, p.position_name AS positionName, e.hire_date AS hireDate, e.termination_date AS terminationDate, e.employment_status AS employmentStatus, e.employment_type AS employmentType, e.profile_file_id AS profileFileId, e.memo, a.login_id AS loginId, a.account_status AS accountStatus FROM employees e LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.position_id = e.position_id LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.employee_id = e.employee_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE employees SET department_id = #{departmentId}, position_id = #{positionId}, employee_number = #{employeeNumber}, employee_name = #{employeeName}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, hire_date = #{hireDate}, employment_status = #{employmentStatus}, employment_type = #{employmentType}, memo = #{memo}, termination_date = CASE WHEN #{employmentStatus} = 'RESIGNED' THEN COALESCE(termination_date, CURRENT_DATE()) ELSE NULL END, version = version + 1 WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO departments (company_id, parent_department_id, leader_employee_id, department_code, department_name, description, sort_order) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{parentDepartmentId}, #{leaderEmployeeId}, #{departmentCode}, #{departmentName}, #{description}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE departments SET deleted_at = NOW(6), active = FALSE WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND department_id = #{departmentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employees e WHERE e.department_id = departments.department_id AND e.deleted_at IS NULL)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO positions (company_id, position_code, position_name, position_level, sort_order) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{positionCode}, #{positionName}, #{positionLevel}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE positions SET deleted_at = NOW(6), active = FALSE WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND position_id = #{positionId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employees e WHERE e.position_id = positions.position_id AND e.deleted_at IS NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT lb.leave_balance_id AS leaveBalanceId, lb.balance_year AS balanceYear, lb.granted_days AS grantedDays, lb.carried_over_days AS carriedOverDays, lb.adjustment_days AS adjustmentDays, lb.used_days AS usedDays, lb.pending_days AS pendingDays, lb.expired_days AS expiredDays, lb.remaining_days AS remainingDays, lb.available_days AS availableDays FROM leave_balances lb WHERE lb.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND lb.balance_year = #{year}

SELECT lb.leave_balance_id AS leaveBalanceId, lb.available_days AS availableDays, lb.remaining_days AS remainingDays, lb.pending_days AS pendingDays FROM leave_balances lb WHERE lb.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND lb.balance_year = #{year} FOR UPDATE
SELECT leader_employee_id FROM departments WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT e.employee_id FROM accounts a JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = a.employee_id JOIN account_roles ar ON ar.account_id = a.account_id JOIN roles r ON r.role_id = ar.role_id WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND r.role_code = 'ROLE_ADMIN' AND e.employee_id != #{excludeEmployeeId} AND a.account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY e.employee_id LIMIT 1
SELECT account_id FROM accounts WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_documents (company_id, drafter_employee_id, document_number, title, content, document_type, business_type, status, current_step_order, submitted_at) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{drafterEmployeeId}, #{documentNumber}, #{title}, #{content}, #{documentType}, #{businessType}, 'PENDING', 1, NOW(6))

INSERT INTO approval_lines (approval_document_id, step_order, line_type, approver_employee_id, required, status, requested_at) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{stepOrder}, 'APPROVAL', #{approverEmployeeId}, TRUE, #{status}, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PENDING' THEN NOW(6) ELSE NULL END)

INSERT INTO leave_requests (employee_id, leave_type_id, leave_balance_id, approval_document_id, leave_unit, start_date, end_date, requested_days, reason, status, submitted_at) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{leaveTypeId}, #{leaveBalanceId}, #{documentId}, #{leaveUnit}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{requestedDays}, #{reason}, 'PENDING', NOW(6))

INSERT INTO notifications (recipient_account_id, actor_account_id, notification_type, title, message, link_url, reference_type, reference_id) VALUES (#{recipientAccountId}, #{actorAccountId}, #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{message}, #{linkUrl}, #{referenceType}, #{referenceId})
mapper.select: SELECT al.approval_line_id AS approvalLineId, ad.approval_document_id AS documentId, ad.document_number AS documentNumber, ad.title, ad.document_type AS documentType, ad.business_type AS businessType, de.employee_name AS drafterName, dd.department_name AS drafterDepartment, al.step_order AS stepOrder, al.requested_at AS requestedAt FROM approval_lines al JOIN approval_documents ad ON ad.approval_document_id = al.approval_document_id JOIN employees de ON de.employee_id = ad.drafter_employee_id LEFT JOIN departments dd ON dd.department_id = de.department_id WHERE al.approver_employee_id = #{employeeId} AND al.status = 'PENDING' AND ad.status = 'PENDING' AND ad.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY al.requested_at

SELECT DISTINCT ad.approval_document_id AS documentId, ad.document_number AS documentNumber, ad.title, ad.document_type AS documentType, ad.business_type AS businessType, ad.status, ad.submitted_at AS submittedAt, ad.completed_at AS completedAt, ad.created_at AS createdAt, de.employee_name AS drafterName, d.department_name AS departmentName FROM approval_documents ad JOIN employees de ON de.employee_id = ad.drafter_employee_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = de.department_id LEFT JOIN approval_lines al ON al.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id WHERE ad.company_id = #{companyId} AND ad.deleted_at IS NULL AND (#{admin} = TRUE OR ad.drafter_employee_id = #{employeeId} OR al.approver_employee_id = #{employeeId}) ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT DISTINCT ad.approval_document_id AS documentId, ad.document_number AS documentNumber, ad.title, ad.content, ad.document_type AS documentType, ad.business_type AS businessType, ad.business_id AS businessId, ad.status, ad.current_step_order AS currentStepOrder, ad.submitted_at AS submittedAt, ad.completed_at AS completedAt, de.employee_name AS drafterName, d.department_name AS departmentName, p.position_name AS positionName FROM approval_documents ad JOIN employees de ON de.employee_id = ad.drafter_employee_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = de.department_id LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.position_id = de.position_id LEFT JOIN approval_lines al ON al.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id WHERE ad.company_id = #{companyId} AND ad.approval_document_id = #{documentId} AND ad.deleted_at IS NULL AND (#{admin} = TRUE OR ad.drafter_employee_id = #{employeeId} OR al.approver_employee_id = #{employeeId}) LIMIT 1

SELECT al.approval_line_id AS approvalLineId, al.step_order AS stepOrder, al.approver_employee_id AS approverEmployeeId, al.status, al.opinion, al.rejection_reason AS rejectionReason, al.requested_at AS requestedAt, al.acted_at AS actedAt, e.employee_name AS approverName, p.position_name AS approverPosition, d.department_name AS approverDepartment FROM approval_lines al JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = al.approver_employee_id LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.position_id = e.position_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id WHERE al.approval_document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY al.step_order

SELECT fa.file_id AS fileId, fa.original_name AS originalName, fa.content_type AS contentType, fa.size_bytes AS sizeBytes FROM approval_document_attachments ada JOIN file_assets fa ON fa.file_id = ada.file_id WHERE ada.approval_document_id = #{documentId} AND fa.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY ada.sort_order, fa.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO approval_document_attachments (approval_document_id, file_id) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{fileId})
mapper.select: SELECT al.approval_line_id AS lineId, al.step_order AS stepOrder, al.status AS lineStatus, ad.status AS documentStatus, ad.business_type AS businessType, ad.business_id AS businessId, ad.drafter_employee_id AS drafterEmployeeId, ad.title FROM approval_lines al JOIN approval_documents ad ON ad.approval_document_id = al.approval_document_id WHERE al.approval_document_id = #{documentId} AND al.approver_employee_id = #{approverEmployeeId} AND al.status = 'PENDING' AND ad.status = 'PENDING' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_lines SET status = 'APPROVED', opinion = #{opinion}, acted_at = NOW(6) WHERE approval_line_id = #{lineId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE approval_lines SET status = 'REJECTED', rejection_reason = #{reason}, acted_at = NOW(6) WHERE approval_line_id = #{lineId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT approval_line_id AS lineId, step_order AS stepOrder, approver_employee_id AS approverEmployeeId FROM approval_lines WHERE approval_document_id = #{documentId} AND step_order > #{stepOrder} AND status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY step_order LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_lines SET status = 'PENDING', requested_at = NOW(6) WHERE approval_line_id = #{lineId} AND status = 'WAITING'
UPDATE approval_documents SET current_step_order = #{stepOrder}, version = version + 1 WHERE approval_document_id = #{documentId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE approval_documents SET status = #{status}, completed_at = NOW(6), version = version + 1 WHERE approval_document_id = #{documentId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT lr.leave_request_id AS leaveRequestId, lr.leave_balance_id AS leaveBalanceId, lr.employee_id AS employeeId, lr.start_date AS startDate, lr.end_date AS endDate, lr.requested_days AS requestedDays, lr.status, lt.leave_type_name AS leaveTypeName FROM leave_requests lr JOIN leave_types lt ON lt.leave_type_id = lr.leave_type_id WHERE lr.approval_document_id = #{documentId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE leave_requests SET status = 'APPROVED', approved_at = NOW(6), version = version + 1 WHERE leave_request_id = #{leaveRequestId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE leave_requests SET status = 'REJECTED', rejection_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 WHERE leave_request_id = #{leaveRequestId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE leave_balances SET pending_days = GREATEST(0, pending_days - #{days}), used_days = used_days + #{days}, version = version + 1 WHERE leave_balance_id = #{leaveBalanceId}
UPDATE leave_balances SET pending_days = GREATEST(0, pending_days - #{days}), version = version + 1 WHERE leave_balance_id = #{leaveBalanceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_transactions (leave_balance_id, leave_request_id, transaction_type, idempotency_key, days, effective_date, description, created_by_account_id) VALUES (#{leaveBalanceId}, #{leaveRequestId}, #{transactionType}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{days}, #{effectiveDate}, #{description}, #{createdByAccountId})

INSERT INTO calendar_events (company_id, organizer_employee_id, event_type, title, description, location, starts_at, ends_at, all_day, visibility, source_type, source_id, color) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{organizerEmployeeId}, #{eventType}, #{title}, #{description}, #{location}, #{startsAt}, #{endsAt}, #{allDay}, #{visibility}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{color})

INSERT INTO approval_histories (approval_document_id, approval_line_id, actor_employee_id, action_type, from_status, to_status, comment_text) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{lineId}, #{actorEmployeeId}, #{actionType}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{comment})
mapper.select: SELECT attendance_record_id AS attendanceRecordId, work_date AS workDate, scheduled_start_at AS scheduledStartAt, scheduled_end_at AS scheduledEndAt, clock_in_at AS clockInAt, clock_out_at AS clockOutAt, work_minutes AS workMinutes, overtime_minutes AS overtimeMinutes, late_minutes AS lateMinutes, early_leave_minutes AS earlyLeaveMinutes, status FROM attendance_records WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND work_date = #{workDate}

SELECT wp.work_policy_id AS workPolicyId, wp.work_start_time AS workStartTime, wp.work_end_time AS workEndTime, wp.break_minutes AS breakMinutes, wp.late_grace_minutes AS lateGraceMinutes, wp.early_leave_grace_minutes AS earlyLeaveGraceMinutes, wp.standard_work_minutes AS standardWorkMinutes FROM employee_work_policy_assignments ewa JOIN work_policies wp ON wp.work_policy_id = ewa.work_policy_id WHERE ewa.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ewa.effective_from <= #{workDate} AND (ewa.effective_to IS NULL OR ewa.effective_to >= #{workDate}) ORDER BY ewa.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_records (employee_id, work_policy_id, work_date, scheduled_start_at, scheduled_end_at, clock_in_at, late_minutes, status) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{workPolicyId}, #{workDate}, #{scheduledStartAt}, #{scheduledEndAt}, #{clockInAt}, #{lateMinutes}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_records SET clock_out_at = #{clockOutAt}, break_minutes = #{breakMinutes}, work_minutes = #{workMinutes}, overtime_minutes = #{overtimeMinutes}, early_leave_minutes = #{earlyLeaveMinutes}, status = #{status}, version = version + 1 WHERE attendance_record_id = #{attendanceRecordId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND clock_out_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_records WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT attendance_record_id AS attendanceRecordId, work_date AS workDate, clock_in_at AS clockInAt, clock_out_at AS clockOutAt, work_minutes AS workMinutes, overtime_minutes AS overtimeMinutes, late_minutes AS lateMinutes, early_leave_minutes AS earlyLeaveMinutes, status FROM attendance_records WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY work_date DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notices WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND published = TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL
AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT n.notice_id AS noticeId, n.notice_category_id AS categoryId, nc.category_name AS categoryName, n.author_account_id AS authorAccountId, n.title, n.content, n.pinned, n.published, n.view_count AS viewCount, n.published_at AS publishedAt, e.employee_name AS authorName FROM notices n LEFT JOIN notice_categories nc ON nc.notice_category_id = n.notice_category_id JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = n.author_account_id JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = a.employee_id WHERE n.company_id = #{companyId} AND n.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND n.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT fa.file_id AS fileId, fa.original_name AS originalName, fa.content_type AS contentType, fa.size_bytes AS sizeBytes FROM notice_attachments na JOIN file_assets fa ON fa.file_id = na.file_id WHERE na.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND fa.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY na.sort_order, fa.created_at
mapper.update: UPDATE notices SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notices (company_id, notice_category_id, author_account_id, title, content, pinned, published, published_at) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{categoryId}, #{authorAccountId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{pinned}, #{published}, CASE WHEN #{published} THEN NOW(6) ELSE NULL END)
mapper.update: UPDATE notices SET notice_category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, pinned = #{pinned}, published = #{published}, published_at = CASE WHEN #{published} THEN COALESCE(published_at, NOW(6)) ELSE NULL END, version = version + 1 WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND notice_id = #{noticeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO notice_attachments (notice_id, file_id) VALUES (#{noticeId}, #{fileId})
mapper.select: SELECT notice_category_id AS categoryId, category_name AS categoryName FROM notice_categories WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND active = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resources WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND published = TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL
AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resources (company_id, author_account_id, title, description, published) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{authorAccountId}, #{title}, #{description}, TRUE)
INSERT INTO resource_files (resource_id, file_id) VALUES (#{resourceId}, #{fileId})

INSERT INTO file_assets (company_id, uploader_account_id, original_name, stored_name, storage_provider, storage_key, content_type, extension, size_bytes, checksum_sha256, image_width, image_height, scan_status) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{uploaderAccountId}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, 'LOCAL', #{storageKey}, #{contentType}, #{extension}, #{sizeBytes}, #{checksumSha256}, #{imageWidth}, #{imageHeight}, 'SAFE')
mapper.select: SELECT file_id AS fileId, company_id AS companyId, original_name AS originalName, storage_key AS storageKey, content_type AS contentType, size_bytes AS sizeBytes FROM file_assets WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_access_logs (file_id, account_id, action_type, ip_address) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{accountId}, 'DOWNLOAD', #{ip})
mapper.update: UPDATE resources r JOIN resource_files rf ON rf.resource_id = r.resource_id SET r.download_count = r.download_count + 1 WHERE rf.file_id = #{fileId}
mapper.select: SELECT ce.calendar_event_id AS eventId, ce.event_type AS eventType, ce.title, ce.description, ce.location, ce.starts_at AS startsAt, ce.ends_at AS endsAt, ce.all_day AS allDay, ce.visibility, ce.color, ce.organizer_employee_id AS organizerEmployeeId, oe.employee_name AS organizerName FROM calendar_events ce JOIN employees oe ON oe.employee_id = ce.organizer_employee_id WHERE ce.company_id = #{companyId} AND ce.deleted_at IS NULL AND ce.canceled_at IS NULL AND ce.starts_at < #{to} AND ce.ends_at >= #{from} AND (ce.visibility = 'COMPANY' OR ce.organizer_employee_id = #{employeeId} OR (ce.visibility = 'DEPARTMENT' AND oe.department_id = (SELECT department_id FROM employees WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId})) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM calendar_event_participants cep WHERE cep.calendar_event_id = ce.calendar_event_id AND cep.employee_id = #{employeeId})) ORDER BY ce.starts_at

SELECT m.message_id AS messageId, m.subject, m.body, m.read_at AS readAt, m.created_at AS createdAt, se.employee_name AS senderName, sa.account_id AS senderAccountId FROM internal_messages m JOIN accounts sa ON sa.account_id = m.sender_account_id JOIN employees se ON se.employee_id = sa.employee_id WHERE m.recipient_account_id = #{accountId} AND m.recipient_deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT m.message_id AS messageId, m.subject, m.body, m.read_at AS readAt, m.created_at AS createdAt, re.employee_name AS recipientName FROM internal_messages m JOIN accounts ra ON ra.account_id = m.recipient_account_id JOIN employees re ON re.employee_id = ra.employee_id WHERE m.sender_account_id = #{accountId} AND m.sender_deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO internal_messages (sender_account_id, recipient_account_id, subject, body) VALUES (#{senderAccountId}, #{recipientAccountId}, #{subject}, #{body})
mapper.select: SELECT notification_id AS notificationId, notification_type AS notificationType, title, message, link_url AS linkUrl, read_at AS readAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM notifications WHERE recipient_account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE recipient_account_id = #{accountId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET read_at = NOW(6) WHERE recipient_account_id = #{accountId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT entityType, entityId, title, subtitle, linkUrl, createdAt FROM ( SELECT 'EMPLOYEE' AS entityType, CAST(e.employee_id AS CHAR) AS entityId, e.employee_name AS title, CONCAT_WS(' · ', e.employee_number, d.department_name, p.position_name) AS subtitle, CONCAT('/employees?keyword=', e.employee_number) AS linkUrl, e.created_at AS createdAt FROM employees e LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.position_id = e.position_id WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND (e.employee_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.employee_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'NOTICE', CAST(n.notice_id AS CHAR), n.title, LEFT(REPLACE(REPLACE(n.content, '\r', ' '), '\n', ' '), 120), CONCAT('/notices/', n.notice_id), n.created_at FROM notices n WHERE n.company_id = #{companyId} AND n.published = TRUE AND n.deleted_at IS NULL AND (n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'RESOURCE', CAST(r.resource_id AS CHAR), r.title, LEFT(COALESCE(r.description, ''), 120), '/resources', r.created_at FROM resources r WHERE r.company_id = #{companyId} AND r.published = TRUE AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND (r.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'APPROVAL', CAST(ad.approval_document_id AS CHAR), ad.title, CONCAT(ad.status, ' · ', de.employee_name), CONCAT('/approvals/', ad.approval_document_id), ad.created_at FROM approval_documents ad JOIN employees de ON de.employee_id = ad.drafter_employee_id LEFT JOIN approval_lines al ON al.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id WHERE ad.company_id = #{companyId} AND ad.deleted_at IS NULL AND ad.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND (ad.drafter_employee_id = #{employeeId} OR al.approver_employee_id = #{employeeId}) ) combined ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT 40
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_histories (account_id, keyword, search_scope, result_count) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{keyword}, 'ALL', #{resultCount})
mapper.select: SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_number AS employeeNumber, e.employee_name AS employeeName, e.email, e.phone, e.hire_date AS hireDate, e.employment_status AS employmentStatus, e.employment_type AS employmentType, e.profile_file_id AS profileFileId, d.department_name AS departmentName, p.position_name AS positionName, a.account_id AS accountId, a.login_id AS loginId, a.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, a.last_login_ip AS lastLoginIp, a.password_changed_at AS passwordChangedAt FROM employees e JOIN accounts a ON a.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.position_id = e.position_id WHERE e.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT success, failure_reason AS failureReason, ip_address AS ipAddress, user_agent AS userAgent, logged_in_at AS loggedInAt FROM login_histories WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY logged_in_at DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT password_hash FROM accounts WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.update: UPDATE accounts SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, password_changed_at = NOW(6), must_change_password = FALSE WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE accounts a JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = a.employee_id SET a.password_hash = #{passwordHash}, a.password_changed_at = NOW(6), a.must_change_password = TRUE, a.failed_login_count = 0, a.account_status = 'ACTIVE', a.locked_until = NULL WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE employees SET profile_file_id = #{fileId}, version = version + 1 WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT e.employee_number AS employeeNumber, e.employee_name AS employeeName, e.email, e.phone, d.department_name AS departmentName, p.position_name AS positionName, e.hire_date AS hireDate, e.employment_status AS employmentStatus FROM employees e LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.position_id = e.position_id WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY e.employee_number

SELECT e.employee_number AS employeeNumber, e.employee_name AS employeeName, d.department_name AS departmentName, lt.leave_type_name AS leaveTypeName, lr.start_date AS startDate, lr.end_date AS endDate, lr.requested_days AS requestedDays, lr.status, lr.reason FROM leave_requests lr JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = lr.employee_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id JOIN leave_types lt ON lt.leave_type_id = lr.leave_type_id WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY lr.start_date DESC

SELECT n.title, nc.category_name AS categoryName, e.employee_name AS authorName, n.view_count AS viewCount, n.published_at AS publishedAt FROM notices n LEFT JOIN notice_categories nc ON nc.notice_category_id = n.notice_category_id JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = n.author_account_id JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = a.employee_id WHERE n.company_id = #{companyId} AND n.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY n.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_logs (company_id, actor_account_id, action_type, entity_type, entity_id, description, request_method, request_uri, ip_address, occurred_at) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{actorAccountId}, #{actionType}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{description}, #{requestMethod}, #{requestUri}, #{ipAddress}, NOW(6))
